rationale: The discourse has moved from positions to a quantified test, but the core contest remains unresolved: employee/state red lines on no closures and no compulsory redundancies versus management/investor insistence on credible structural downsizing if the residual gap proves large. Round 4 adds expert validation of the decision criterion, yet no side has actually bridged the gap or changed its stance, so the process is circling around a stable impasse rather than converging.
